claims.text: Vulnerability constitutes the core of anxiety disorders.
Threat reactions in anxiety are governed by cognitive structures and anxiogenic rules.
Cognitive therapy addresses anxiety by restructuring patient assumptions across cognitive, affective, and behavioral components.

evidence.description: Text explicitly identifies 'Vulnerability: The Core of Anxiety Disorders' as a primary theoretical premise.
Text details 'The Cognitive Model of Threat Reactions' and 'Cognitive Structures and Anxiogenic Rules' as conceptual components of anxiety.
Text outlines cognitive restructuring techniques aimed at modifying imagery, affective components, behavioral components, and major patient assumptions.

methodologies.name: Cognitive Therapy for Anxiety Disorders
methodologies.description: A therapeutic approach involving cognitive restructuring, imagery modification, affective adaptation, and behavioral modification to change core assumptions.
